decisions.rationale: Decided: Firstmate decision react-forms-loop4-correction (inbox 016, 2026-11-18) authorized one bounded fourth correction loop: the label query scoped to the submitted form with a fail-closed message, a complementary team-value variant instead of narrowed wording, the split-test expected-output wording, the wrapped and completed starter hint including notify, and an accurate message for empty or todo-only learner files. Implemented at commit 044631bf (044631bf21b8379686296ca9e885a736707c8b95); current lab.json sha256 5fa2f584.... The loop-5 education recheck marks this finding resolved. Verified: tests/task8-variant.jsx now finds the name and team fields with the Testing Library label query, scoped to the submitted form. With only the team caption changed to a label wrapping the select, the solved test is accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0, and a blank-only partial test on the same form is still rejected with the four completed-submission messages. With the name label replaced by a span referenced through aria-labelledby, the solved test is accepted. The fail-closed path was exercised by pointing a scratch-only copy of the variant at a caption the form does not have: npm test then exits 1 with the single learner-safe message that the check could not find the 'Service name' and 'Owning team' fields by their labels, instead of the old misleading 'add this check' lines. Reconciler-verified at 044631bf in a fresh 0700 scratch copy made with git archive, with the private overlay copied over the starter (macOS darwin, Node 24.2.0, npm 11.3.0). The shipped starter still fails all 8 tests and the oracle is not reached; the private solution passes 8/8 and prints the Task 8 line with exit 0. Original loop-4 reconciliation (escalate), kept for the record: Claim verified true; consolidated with sme-fcc-u1. Reproduced by the reconciler on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 8543f338 with the private overlay copied over the starter. With only the team caption changed from an htmlFor label to a label that wraps the select, all eight tests pass (Tests 8 passed (8)), yet npm test exits 1 and lists the blank-ignored, blank-saves and complete-ignored misses, each telling the learner to add an assertion the solved test already makes. Cause, confirmed from the code: fieldByLabel compares the label's raw trimmed textContent with the exact caption, and a wrapping label around a select also contains every option's text, so readForm returns null and the three document-listener variants never inject their fault. Test 2 uses getByLabelText, which accepts this markup, and the accessible-forms topic teaches wrapping as a valid association, so a learner can reach this by following the module. The learner cannot fix it by changing the test. This medium finding is the one that requires a fourth loop. Fix direction (one consolidated fix for edu-fcc-u1 and sme-fcc-u1): in tests/task8-variant.jsx, replace the hand-written fieldByLabel lookup with the label-text query from @testing-library/dom (already a pinned devDependency), scoped to the submitted form element, taking the first match for 'Service name' and 'Owning team'. The variant then finds a field exactly when the public test 2 does. Also make readForm fail closed: if either field cannot be found, the verifier should report that the Task 8 check could not read the form and name the two labels it expects, instead of silently counting the variant as not caught. Add the wrapping-label and aria-labelledby forms to the private adversarial controls recorded with the solved run. Feasibility: the reconciler trialled only the label-query change in scratch; with it, the wrapping-label select form and the aria-labelledby name field are accepted, the unchanged solved form and a split test are still accepted, and a blank-only partial test is still rejected with the three completed-submission messages. The fail-closed message was not trialled. Correction-loop status: this lab has already had three correction loops (89064f80, 30cd7583 and 8543f338). authoring/docs/workflow.md section 2.4 allows a second loop once and says a third escalates, so any byte-changing fix here is a fourth correction loop and needs Firstmate's authorization. The author must not edit any lab byte for this finding until Firstmate authorizes that loop.

Revision at 044631bf: decision unchanged and evidence unchanged in substance. The loop-5 SME recheck marks it open only because the claim still reproduces, and raises no new escalation. Original loop-4 reconciliation: Claim verified true in its reproducible part; no change warranted. Reproduced by the reconciler on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 8543f338 with the private overlay copied over the starter. The fiber-walk probe (a) was critic-reported, not rerun. Why no change: the control's footprint can only be detected by a test that deliberately instruments the document's listener registration or walks React internals, which is harness-aware gaming, not an honest attempt at the task. The critic found no innocent test that hits it, and the TEAMS, DOM-tag, env-var and identity probes are all rejected. Task 8 is formative practice, and the README says the check scores behaviour while the learner self-checks the rest. The loop-3 plan aimed for variants with no footprint against innocent structural probes, and that aim is met. Spending a fourth-loop byte change on an adversarial-only residual is not justified. If Firstmate nonetheless authorizes it, the SME's verified direction (register the same capture listener in every variant, control included, and always wrap onSave) is the fix; it was not rerun by the reconciler.

Revision at 044631bf: decision unchanged; one premise corrected. The loop-5 SME recheck marks it open because it still reproduces. Reconciler-reproduced at 044631bf (fresh 0700 scratch, private overlay, macOS, Node 24.2.0, TMPDIR pointed at a private directory): a correct test that writes 2 MiB to process.stdout passes 8/8, then npm test prints 'Could not start Vitest: spawnSync <node> ENOBUFS' and exits 1. Correction: the loop-4 rationale said the leftover is an empty directory. Two leftovers were observed: the empty task8-* directory and a second, randomly named directory of about 52 KB, which appeared only after the killed child (its owner, presumably the Vitest child's temporary state, was not confirmed). Both are in the OS temp directory, outside the lab tree. The trigger is unchanged: a raw stdout or stderr write of more than 1 MiB inside a unit test, which no task invites, while console.log output is unaffected. So the correction does not change the decision. Changing the bytes now would be a fifth correction loop, which Firstmate's react-forms-loop4-correction decision does not authorize. Original loop-4 reconciliation: Claim verified true; no change warranted. Reproduced by the reconciler on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 8543f338 with the private overlay copied over the starter. A correct learner test that writes 2 MiB directly to process.stdout passes 8/8, and then npm test prints 'Could not start Vitest: spawnSync <node> ENOBUFS' and exits 1, leaving an empty task8-* directory in the temp dir. That matches the Node v24.2.0 child_process documentation the critic cites: spawnSync's default maxBuffer is 1024*1024 bytes. The Ctrl+C leak was critic-reported, not rerun. Why no change: the trigger is a raw process.stdout or stderr write of more than 1 MiB inside a unit test, which no task in this lab asks for or invites. The critic confirms that a 2 MiB console.log is accepted normally, because Vitest does not route console output to the JSON run's stdout. The verdict for an honest test is unaffected, and the leftover is an empty directory in the OS temp dir, not in the lab. This does not justify a fourth-loop byte change. If Firstmate authorizes a loop that already touches tests/verify-learner-test.mjs, the critic's direction (ignore stdout for variant runs, keep a bounded stderr tail, report the real error code once the normal run has started, and remove the temp directory in a finally block) is a safe ride-along; it was not trialled by the reconciler.
